decisions.reason: The carpet still has its own page in its second year and sits close to the established offer, so the firm keeps it as part of a collection it has publicly committed to, even though a sister design (C) was already dropped.
A hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a high-investment showcase of craftsmanship and fine materials, so management stays committed to it and treats slow sales as temporary.

The corner bench moved from its own page to a mention, a sign of fading visibility, but it was promoted as a new interpretation of a classic, which publicly ties the firm to it and argues for giving it more time.
The low-pile carpet keeps its own page and fits the established rug range, so the small sunk design effort and visible presence favour keeping it.
The swivel shell chair is a multi-model line central to the firm's seating offer with substantial tooling and designer investment, making a drop very unlikely.
